request.summary: Roll out the router across two staffed rigs

shared_understanding.statement: The rollout staffs both rigs using the resolved staffing model and topology.
Only the two named rigs are in scope for this rollout.
Staffing model and rig topology are decided by the linked Wayfinding Run before to-spec.
Both rigs are staffed and reachable per the resolved topology.
Requested by Benjamin on 2026-09-24 to unblock router fixture testing of the Wayfinding path.
None needed; the rollout's shape is fully determined by the resolved decisions.
This does not roll out to any rig beyond the two named ones.
